svg.desc: 958 commits across five public projects, 68 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-26 through 2026-11-17 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-17T00:46:07.932Z.
